Read "Thruster Valves - Valcor Engineering Corporation": Direct-acting coaxial thruster valves don't require system pressure to operate and have zero internal leak rate.
tapping metallic beats while searching the wire for high temp cooling valves

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Wire Search for Cooling Valves"

He invented a new part: a titanium-grade engine mount washer! i hammered the scorched heat tile flat and punched a clean core through it. *bweep*
welding a custom titanium-grade engine mount washer at the workbench
